what-is-humanity-union.title: What is {siteName}?
what-is-humanity-union.purpose: What is {siteName} and what problem does it address?
what-is-humanity-union.overview: {siteName} is a civic technology platform for structured, transparent participation. It helps communities move from shared concern to documented civic action — without replacing institutions.

role.heading: Platform role
role.body: {siteName} provides workspace tools, public civic records, and educational reference material. It documents processes; it does not decide outcomes for participants.

audience.heading: Who it serves
audience.body: Participants, guests, researchers, journalists, and future institutional partners can all read public records and learn how civic workflows operate.

platform-overview.title: Platform Overview
platform-overview.purpose: How are the main parts of the platform organized?
platform-overview.overview: The platform has three public-facing layers: Knowledge Center (education), Public Experience (published civic records), and participant Workspace (private civic work).

knowledge.heading: Knowledge Center
knowledge.body: Authoritative explanations of concepts, processes, and terminology. This is where you learn before participating.

public.heading: Public Experience
public.body: Published initiatives, decisions, deliveries, and archives. Anyone can browse without signing in.

workspace.heading: Workspace
workspace.body: Authenticated participants draft initiatives, collaborate, vote, and track implementation.

core-principles.title: Core Principles
core-principles.overview: {siteName} is built on clarity, neutrality, transparency, and participant responsibility. Knowledge explains; it never persuades.

explain.heading: Knowledge explains
explain.body: Educational content describes how processes work. It does not advocate positions or predict outcomes.

neutral.heading: Political neutrality
neutral.body: Platform language stays descriptive. Civic merit is evaluated by participants through governed processes, not by the platform.

records.heading: Records over rhetoric
records.body: Published civic records are the durable source of civic memory. Public pages reference those records.

how-humanity-union-works.title: How {siteName} Works
how-humanity-union-works.purpose: What is the basic flow from concern to civic record?
how-humanity-union-works.overview: A participant declares an initiative, collaborates through analysis and proposals, opens collective decisions, and may deliver civic action packages to institutions. Outcomes are tracked and archived publicly.

start.heading: Start with an initiative
start.body: An initiative frames a civic question or proposed action within a participation area.

pipeline.heading: Follow the civic pipeline
pipeline.body: Analysis, proposals, revisions, decision sessions, collective decisions, and implementation stages build a documented trail.

public.heading: Publish and archive
public.body: Published records appear in Public Experience. Completed work may enter the Public Civic Archive.

management-coordination.title: 1. Centralized Management & Coordination
management-coordination.body: The Humanity Protection Command Center (HPC) serves as the sole strategic coordination hub for all operations of the World Protection Corps (WPC). This center: - Directs global security, defense, rescue, and humanitarian missions. - Integrates and oversees professional armed forces, specialized military units, rescue services, environmental protection teams, and designated medical personnel. - Operates under the strategic oversight of the Humanity Council, ensuring alignment with global priorities and long-term security objectives.

composition-structure.title: 2. Composition & Structure
composition-structure.body: The WPC is composed of personnel and resources contributed by democratic states based on a proportional system, factoring in: - Total population (ensuring fair representation). - Territorial size (considering geographical responsibilities). - Resource capacity (economic strength, technological capability, and material contributions). Each state fulfills its obligation primarily through financial contributions or equivalent material resources, facilitating the Corps’ operational sustainability.

recruitment-training.title: 3. Recruitment & Training
recruitment-training.body: - A Unified Global Recruitment System ensures selection based on strict competency, skill, and ethical standards. - The World Protection Training Center (WPTC) conducts standardized training for all personnel, focusing on defense, crisis response, environmental protection, and medical aid. - Specialized divisions within the WPC include: * Military & Security Forces (global peacekeeping and protection). * Rescue & Emergency Response Units (disaster relief and crisis intervention). * Environmental Protection Teams (ecological crisis management and resource conservation). * Medical & Support Services (personnel welfare and mission sustainability).

deployment-command.title: 4. Operational Deployment & Command
deployment-command.body: - The HPC deploys personnel based on real-time global threats and emergencies. - Task forces operate under joint command structures, ensuring adaptability and efficiency. - The Corps maintains rapid response capabilities, supported by a global logistics and resource network.

financial-logistical.title: 5. Financial & Logistical Support
financial-logistical.body: - Democratic states fund and equip the WPC through structured contributions. - Resources include financial assets, technology, military-grade equipment, and humanitarian supplies. - A Global Logistics Division manages supply chains, operational readiness, and mission sustainability.

integration-bodies.title: 6. Integration with National & International Bodies
integration-bodies.body: - Professional armed forces of contributing states integrate into WPC command structures while retaining national oversight. - International organizations (e.g., humanitarian agencies, environmental groups) collaborate with WPC to enhance mission effectiveness.

legal-ethical.title: 7. Legal & Ethical Foundations
legal-ethical.body: -The Humanity Council serves as the highest governing body, making strategic decisions on the elimination of causes and prevention of global military conflicts, environmental sabotage, and responses to natural disasters. - Decisions are based on consultations, expert analyses, and recommendations from the Chamber of Intellectual Analysis, ensuring a rational, knowledge-based approach to global security. - The World Protection Corps does not maintain neutrality in global conflicts that threaten all of humanity but instead actively eliminates root causes of conflict and prevents escalations through strategic interventions. - The Corps operates under a strict legal framework, ensuring all actions comply with democratic principles, international law, and ethical governance. - Operational mandates include: * Preventing state or non-state actors from triggering global instability. * Protecting the environment from large-scale destructive activities. * Responding decisively to humanitarian and natural crises.

intro.heading: Introduction
intro.subheading: A personal contribution to our shared future
intro.p1: The development of the <platform>Humanity Union platform</platform> is a personal contribution each of us can make to our own future and to the future of generations to come.
intro.p2: If our ancestors had access to the technological tools we have today — the Internet, computers, smartphones, and educational and informational web platforms — our societies might have developed a higher level of social awareness and responsibility much earlier.
intro.p3: Greater social literacy helps people make more thoughtful and rational decisions. Such decisions create the foundation for social justice, well-being, and security.
intro.p4: We are a unique generation. We have lived through the transition from a largely traditional world into an age that gives ordinary people powerful technological tools for communication, education, cooperation, and collective action.
intro.p5: With these opportunities comes a choice. We can continue accumulating the consequences of old patterns of ignorance, fear, greed, and aggression, or we can develop new principles based on knowledge, responsibility, cooperation, and respect for human dignity.
intro.p6: Humanity has enough knowledge, experience, and potential to progress without aggression and tragedy.
intro.p7: Today, almost anyone can take a device in their hands and influence the world around them. Every responsible action can become another small part of a strong foundation for humanity — a foundation built on <emphasis>love, responsibility, and security</emphasis>.
intro.honeyEarthAlt: Illustration of Earth with a honeycomb pattern, suggesting shared care for our common home

meaning.heading: What It Means to Be a Volunteer
meaning.subheading: More than a title — a sign of responsibility
meaning.p1: A <emphasis>Volunteer</emphasis> is not a title. It is a sign of responsibility — one that society often underestimates.
meaning.p2: Much of our world is supported and improved by volunteers, enthusiasts, and people who decide to act without waiting for someone else to act first. But enthusiasm alone does not always lead to positive results. Education, values, upbringing, and understanding influence whether our energy serves progress and the common good or becomes driven by personal ambition, greed, prejudice, or manipulation.
meaning.p3: We do not always notice when we ourselves begin to tolerate ignorance or aggression. Sometimes we spend more effort adapting to harmful circumstances than trying to change them. In doing so, we may unintentionally make life more difficult for ourselves and for others.
meaning.p4: The <platform>Humanity Union platform</platform> is being developed as a safe tool for everyone — whether you live in a democratic society with functioning institutions or under an authoritarian and aggressive regime where people may be intimidated, silenced, or forced into rigid social hierarchies.
meaning.p5: Our central task is simple: <emphasis>to unite around universal human values while respecting national cultures, traditions, and identities that are consistent with fundamental human rights and freedoms.</emphasis>
meaning.p6: You do not need a special position, profession, or status to participate.
meaning.p7: Come to the platform. Explore and support Initiatives created by other people. Participate in discussions, polls, and elections. Create your own Initiative when you see a problem that deserves attention. Help others improve their ideas. Whenever you are able, take part in turning worthwhile Initiatives into real action.
meaning.p8: Every responsible action matters. It contributes to the quality of life and to the development of a more humane society. Inaction also has consequences. When someone feels powerless, unheard, or unable to act, we should not treat that with indifference — it matters to the whole community.
meaning.p9: Do not hesitate to ask a question, share an idea, or ask others for help. Where the platform provides appropriate privacy and safety options, you can protect your identity and participate without unnecessarily exposing yourself to risk.

takePart.heading: Take Part
takePart.p1: You do not have to change the whole world by yourself.
takePart.p2: Bring what you can: your knowledge, experience, time, ideas, questions, professional skills, or simply your willingness to support a good Initiative.
takePart.p3: Take the tools of the <platform>Humanity Union platform</platform> and use them for good.
takePart.p8: Create something that others can continue.
takePart.closing: Every responsible action is a contribution to our shared future.
